scenarios.name: test-copy-card-and-cast-from-exile
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage DelayedBlastFireballTest#testCopyCardAndCastFromExile. 1 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[playcopycard-cast-origin-not-exile]: Mizzix's Mastery casts the exiled card's copy through beginPlay's CopyCard$ path, which records the library holding zone (written for Cipher) as the cast's From, so Count$wasCastFromExile is false and Delayed Blast Fireball deals 2 instead of 5 (p1 life 18, want 15), CR 707.12, 601.2a, verified at gorge 981b98963b.
